title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 1, Fugue 24 in B minor

character.text: Chromatic fugue on a modulating subject, with a plainly diatonic countersubject

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 7–8) in part, with the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals. Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and the opening of the subject. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of the subject. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (3 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and the opening of the subject and the opening of countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 and the opening of the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted and the opening of the subject, in a sequence rising by a fourth every bar.

sections.label: Subject in D major, rhythm varied (Tenor)
Link
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint.

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 6 (bars 56–57).

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 5 (bars 50–53) in part, with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, the bass's line in the tenor, the lines moved by different intervals. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times). Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1.

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from countersubject 1, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 24–29).

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times).
